sourceEvidence.sourceRevisionRead: DIRECT_READ_SUCCESS via native Google Docs text read; rendered math blocks preserved and revision ID recorded.
sourceEvidence.note: Read native Docs text and complete text/plain export for this revision, retaining math blocks. Isolated all Q01-Q26 prompts, choices, answers, solutions, plans and metadata by headings/fences. Local answer/key-step audit completed; corrected conditions and selection/score labels are recorded in changeLog. The MD marks items EXEMPT, but problem/solution visual needs were separately assessed by item. Repaired LaTeX macros lost to tab characters and restored aligned row breaks; corrected Q10 configuration, Q20 independence, and Q23 correspondence/ratio/answer. Original archive untouched; original figures were not linked because similar values/layout are not source-bound. Second-pass review found and repaired Q09 wording (`사각선분` to `선분`) and Q24 LaTeX `\night` to `\right`; all 26 item keys and solutions were checked against independent calculations. The source MD Q23 key/ratio were incorrect and the candidate correction was revalidated. Source Q24 display itself ends after \overline{BC}; the candidate equation was completed as \right)=1/3\overline{BC}, following the prior proven ratios, and its malformed delimiter was corrected. Runtime string audit then found JS source had only one raw backslash before `right)`, which JavaScript interpreted as CR; escaped it as `\\right)` in JS so runtime retains literal `\right)`. Entire questionBank was evaluated to check for non-LF controls.
